name: Operator metrics
description: Prometheus metrics endpoint for the operator's own controller-runtime manager (neo4j_operator_server_health and friends), bound to --metrics-bind-address (default :8080).

name: Operator liveness probe
description: controller-runtime's healthz.Ping liveness check, bound to --health-probe-bind-address (default :8081).

name: Operator readiness probe
description: Readiness check gated on the manager's cache having synced (createReadinessCheck), so the operator isn't marked Ready before it can actually reconcile.
